Chad Stone Rose Smuin Ray Garcia from what I can see, the photo eye right before the reject point doesn’t get triggered long enough to see the marked molds as bad. The short “pull-away” belt creates some spacing between the bars, the stopper gets disabled when bad molds hit de-molding, allowing the spaced bars to go through and those SHOULD theoretically be spaced enough to trigger the photo eyes, which engages the reject. 

The problem I see is that sometimes those spaced bars aren’t spaced enough to actually trigger the photo eyes and the reject function gets bypassed. 

And it definitely seems to compound when we have bigger groups of bad molds.
